artifact_chain.identity: run.json run identity over grid, code (every module/protocol file hash), config, snapshot, software; cell record binds model identity (arrays + metadata), file hashes, prediction identities and scores to run and expected cell
artifact_chain.writes: exclusive and atomic (temp + fsync + os.link; never overwrite, also under a race)
artifact_chain.resume: same run id only with unchanged code/protocol/config/snapshot/grid; every recomputed cell compared with records and orphan files; mismatch -> failed_integrity (terminal); interrupted + resume == uninterrupted run
artifact_chain.integrity: model identity before and after evaluation; records verified on read; G, S, lambda recomputed from verified predictions
artifact_chain.management: study/phase lock, append-only event log with clock-gap (sleep) detection, run status transitions, lifecycle; development/smoke only
artifact_chain.release_gate: technically_complete / scientifically_interpretable / hypothesis (not_evaluated for development) separate; structure check recomputed; missing controls block

extrapolated_full_study.grid: 20 contexts x 7 units x 2 tasks x 7 times = 1960 cells
